translation:
[Figure: Diagram of the crown of the head 20]
The crown (巔) is the top of the head. Its bone has a three-pronged suture in men and a cross-shaped suture in women; it is also called the Heavenly Spirit Cover (天靈蓋). It occupies the highest position, and within it is contained the brain and marrow like a cover, thereby governing the whole body. If one is struck or collided and injured, appearing suddenly dead, with the body stiff, breath and sound passing in and out of the nose and mouth, eyes closed, face the color of earth, and the heart region warm, hot, and beating, this condition can be treated.
